analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard for monitoring fraud risk and compliance performance over time. It brings together trends for fraud alerts (count and value), chargebacks (count and amount), audit finding volume, and compliance adherence scores by month/quarter/year. By default it is scoped to the last 12 months, with region and country filters available to narrow the view.
analyticalDashboards.title: Fraud Risk & Compliance

widget.title: Chargeback Amount and Chargeback Amount by Quarter

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard for monitoring audit findings and fraud/chargeback risk over time, combining headline KPIs (alert value, chargeback count) with monthly/quarterly/yearly trends and comparisons by channel and region. By default it is filtered to the last 12 months, with additional dashboard filters available for store region and sales channel.
analyticalDashboards.title: Audit Findings & Risk

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard that benchmarks compliance adherence, fraud alerts, chargebacks, and audit findings over time to support risk and cost-center monitoring. It combines score and alert headlines with monthly/quarterly/yearly trend charts to spot changes, spikes, and regional or channel differences. By default it is filtered to the last 12 months, with optional filters for store region and sales channel.
analyticalDashboards.title: Compliance & Cost Center Benchmarks

metrics.description: Maximum value of total chargeback amount across the current context (max over grouped totals when broken down by an attribute), while respecting all report filters.
metrics.title: custom_max_total_chargeback

metrics.description: Returns the maximum monetary value recorded for a chargeback amount within the selected data and filters.
metrics.title: Maximum Total Chargeback Amount

metrics.description: Returns the maximum value of the total chargeback amount metric within the selected data and filters.
metrics.title: Maximum Total Chargeback Amount From Total Metric

metrics.description: Totals the number of audit findings by summing the Finding Count values from the Audit Finding dataset. Use it to report overall finding volume and to break results down by dimensions such as time period, audit, or area.
metrics.title: Total Finding Count (Audit Finding)

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value of chargebacks (a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer) by summing Chargeback Amount across the selected data and filters. Use it to monitor overall chargeback exposure and compare totals across time periods or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Chargeback Amount (Chargeback)

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of chargebacks (a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer) by summing Chargeback Count records from the Chargeback dataset. Use it to monitor overall chargeback volume and compare it across time periods, products, or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Chargeback Count (Chargeback)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of fraud alerts by summing Alert Count from the Fraud Alert data, within the current reporting scope (such as the selected time period or applied filters). Use it to track overall alert volume and compare trends across dimensions like time or alert type.
metrics.title: Total Alert Count (Fraud Alert)

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value associated with fraud alerts by summing Alert Value, respecting any filters or segments applied in the current analysis.
metrics.title: Total Alert Value (Fraud Alert)

metrics.description: Totals the Compliance Adherence Score by summing its underlying numeric values, giving the overall compliance adherence across whatever scope is currently selected (such as applied filters, time period, or segments).
metrics.title: Total Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score)

metrics.description: This metric totals the Compliance Adherence Score, restricted to activity in the In-Store sales channel. Use it to track overall in-store compliance adherence performance within the current report’s filters and scope.
metrics.title: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total Compliance Adherence Score filtered to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare compliance performance specifically for Online activity within the current report filters and time period.
metrics.title: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — Online Channel

metrics.description: This metric returns the total Compliance Adherence Score for the North region. Use it to report an overall adherence score for North while still honoring any other filters applied in the report or dashboard.
metrics.title: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts the total number of fraud alerts specifically for the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor in-store fraud alert volume within the current reporting scope (for example, the selected time period and any applied filters).
metrics.title: Alert Count (Fraud Alert) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total number of fraud alerts restricted to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare online fraud alert volume across the currently selected reporting scope (for example, time period or other dashboard filters).
metrics.title: Alert Count (Fraud Alert) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total number of fraud alerts restricted to the North region. Use this metric to monitor fraud alert volume for North and compare it with other regions or across different reporting periods.
metrics.title: Alert Count (Fraud Alert) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value tied to fraud alerts, limited to the In-Store sales channel. Use it to monitor or compare the financial impact of in-store fraud alerts within the current analysis filters.
metrics.title: Alert Value (Fraud Alert) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total monetary value associated with fraud alerts for the Online sales channel, based on the overall fraud alert alert value total but limited to records where the Channel Type is Online.
metrics.title: Alert Value (Fraud Alert) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Totals the monetary value tied to fraud alerts, restricted to the North region. Use it to monitor the financial impact of fraud alerts in North while still respecting any other filters applied in the analysis.
metrics.title: Alert Value (Fraud Alert) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts the total number of chargebacks specifically for the In-Store sales channel. Use it to monitor and compare in-store chargeback volume across time periods, products, or other business dimensions. A chargeback is a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer.
metrics.title: Chargeback Count (Chargeback) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Counts the number of chargebacks for transactions in the Online sales channel (Channel Type = Online). Use this metric to monitor and compare online chargeback volume over time or across other business dimensions. A chargeback is a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer.
metrics.title: Chargeback Count (Chargeback) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Counts the number of chargebacks in the North region only, by applying a Region Name = North filter to the overall chargeback count. Use this metric to monitor and compare North’s chargeback volume across time periods or other business dimensions. A chargeback is a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer.
metrics.title: Chargeback Count (Chargeback) — North Region

metrics.description: Total monetary value of chargebacks, filtered to the In-Store sales channel only. Use this metric to track and compare in-store chargeback exposure across time periods or other business dimensions while excluding other channel types. A chargeback is a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer.
metrics.title: Chargeback Amount (Chargeback) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total monetary value of chargebacks limited to the Online sales channel. Use this to monitor and compare chargeback exposure for online transactions across time periods or other business dimensions. A chargeback is a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer.
metrics.title: Chargeback Amount (Chargeback) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value of chargebacks, limited to the North region. Use this metric to track and compare North’s chargeback exposure across time periods or other business dimensions. A chargeback is a disputed payment transaction reversed by the card issuer.
metrics.title: Chargeback Amount (Chargeback) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts audit findings for the In-Store sales channel only, excluding findings from other channel types. Use this metric to monitor and compare in-store finding volume over time or across audits and areas.
metrics.title: Finding Count (Audit Finding) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Counts audit findings for the Online channel only by filtering the total audit finding count to Channel Type = Online. Use it to monitor and compare finding volume specifically tied to online activity across breakdowns such as time period, audit, or area.
metrics.title: Finding Count (Audit Finding) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of audit findings for the North region only (filtered to Region Name = North). Use this metric to monitor and compare audit finding volume for North across time periods, audits, or other breakdowns.
metrics.title: Finding Count (Audit Finding) — North Region

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in the In-Store Compliance Adherence Score by comparing the current month’s value to the prior month. Use it to see whether in-store compliance adherence is improving or declining over time within the current report filters.
metrics.title: MoM: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in the Compliance Adherence Score for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month to the prior month (based on Month/Year). Use it to see whether Online compliance performance is improving or declining over time under the current report filters.
metrics.title: MoM: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in the Compliance Adherence Score for the North region by comparing the current month’s score to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether adherence is improving or declining over time, while still respecting other report or dashboard filters.
metrics.title: MoM: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the year-over-year percentage change in the Compliance Adherence Score for the In-Store channel, comparing the current year to the previous year in the same reporting context. metrics.title: YoY: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Year-over-year percent change in the Compliance Adherence Score for the Online sales channel, comparing the current period to the same metric in the prior year. Use it to track whether online compliance performance is improving or declining versus last year.
metrics.title: YoY: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Year-over-year percentage change in the Compliance Adherence Score for the North region, comparing the current year to the previous year. Use it to track whether North’s adherence score is improving or declining over time under the same report filters.
metrics.title: YoY: Attribute Value (Compliance Adherence Score) — North Region
